messages.content: "A car starts from rest and travels a distance of 120 meters in 10 seconds. What is the speed of the car at the end of this time period? After reaching this speed, the car continues to accelerate for another 5 seconds from 12 m/s until it reaches a final speed doubling the initial speed. The final speed is twice the speed calculated in the first part. What is the acceleration of the car in this second phase?"

So speed at end of first part is 24 m/s.

Now second phase: starts from 12 m/s? For constant acceleration from rest, average speed = (u+v)/2 = v/2. So v = 24 m/s. So not 12. So maybe they mis-specified. But maybe they want to use average speed as final speed? But then they'd say "speed at the end of this time period" which would be final speed. So they'd get 12 m/s. Then second phase: from 12 m/s to double that, i.e., 24 m/s over 5s. That would give acceleration = (24-12)/5 = 12/5 = 2.4 m/s^2. That matches acceleration from first part.
